def heatmap(counts, title, path):
    years = sorted({c['closeYear'] for c in counts})
    types = sorted({c['assetType'] for c in counts})
    mat = np.zeros((len(types), len(years)))
    idx_y = {y:i for i,y in enumerate(years)}
    idx_t = {t:i for i,t in enumerate(types)}
    for c in counts:
        mat[idx_t[c['assetType']], idx_y[c['closeYear']]] = c['closedPositionEvents']
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(6, 1.2*len(years)+2), max(3.5, 0.45*len(types)+1.5)))
    im = ax.imshow(mat, aspect='auto', cmap='YlOrRd')
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(years)), years)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(types)), types)
    ax.set_title(title)
    for i in range(len(types)):
        for j in range(len(years)):
            v = int(mat[i,j])
            if v:
                ax.text(j, i, str(v), ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8,
                        color='white' if v > mat.max()*0.55 else 'black')
    fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label='closed position events')
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(path, dpi=160)
    plt.close(fig)
    print('wrote', path)
